description: Implementation of the IpcClientImpl class, which manages IPC client connections, including client identification, service export, event sending, and connection status within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: ClientImpl
classes.description: A class that represents an IPC client, managing its connection, associated services, and communication with the server.

methods.name: ClientImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with server reference, client ID, and credentials.

methods.name: getClientPid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the client.

methods.name: getClientUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID of the client.

methods.name: getClientGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID of the client.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the client from the server.

methods.name: exportService
methods.description: Exports a protobuf service for the client.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends a protobuf message event to the server.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.
